text:
Maya Patel: FYI - I noticed preview tiles showing stale rows after switching orgs fast. Steps: open org-omega, open preview, cmd-k to switch to org-sierra, preview briefly flashes omega results. Happened twice in staging.
Samir Khan: saw this too on my laptop. Repro with 3 rapid switches. Tracing shows cache hits that don't contain the request's x-org header. Example: cacheKey=preview:staging:GLOBAL:0xdeadbeef -> HIT while headers say x-org-id=sierra
Leo Zhang: logs pasted:
```
2025-02-10T09:12:30.123Z INFO prefetch start req=abc headers={x-org-id: sierra}
2025-02-10T09:12:30.125Z DEBUG cache lookup key=preview:staging:omega:0xdeadbeef -> HIT
```
Looks like the async prefetch used an org value captured earlier (mutable ctx).
Anya Ortiz: downstream effect: billing aggregates and per-org preview counters are off. We saw a 30% spike for omega in last hour that aligns with switch-heavy sessions. Might trigger SLA alerts.
Tina Gomez: short-term mitigation: reject cache reads from keys whose embedded org != request header. Emit an audit metric when mismatch seen. Longer-term: record immutable orgId at request start and thread it through all async jobs.
Maya Patel: agree. Also can we add a guard in the UI prefetch that cancels outstanding prefetches when workspace switch happens? Less chance of old responses being applied.
Samir Khan: putting together a small infra scan to find other places reusing req.ctx in async closures. Will run grep for "captureOrg|req.ctx" patterns. Need perms to run a backfill if we find telemetry churn.
Leo Zhang: patch idea (will open PR later):
```
const startOrg = req.captureImmutable('orgId')
const key = `preview:${env}:${startOrg}:${hash}`
if (req.headers['x-org-id'] && req.headers['x-org-id'] !== startOrg) {
  metrics.increment('preview.cache.mismatch')
  // do not perform global read
  return null
}
```
That forces the cache to be org-scoped and records mismatches.
Anya Ortiz: I'll draft a reconcile job to reassign preview counts where traces show header/key disagreement. Target timeframe: last 24h. Need to confirm retention window for traces.
Tina Gomez: SRE note: when deploying the guard we should canary for 1h; watch preview latency and cache hit rate. Also add an alert if mismatch metric > 0.1% traffic to avoid noisy alerts.
release-bot: svc-console rollouts: canary started for v2.4.0, monitor at https://rollouts.redwood.internal
Maya Patel: owners: Samir (codebase scan + infra scrub), Leo (cache+patch PR), Anya (telemetry reconcile job), Tina (SRE canary checklist + postmortem template). Drop links to PR and job run plan here once available. Escalate to #incidents if customers impacted. :white_check_mark:
